messages:
Nina Park: quick check1: search turned up a bunch of places using `embedding_vector`, `vector`, and `embedding` interchangeably. it's confusing for users and for our glossary. can we decide on canonical doc terminology + SDK mappings?
Owen Rivera: agreed. for docs I'd prefer the explicit noun `embedding` for the resource and `embedding_id` for identifiers. `vector` can be used when discussing implementation (e.g., cosine similarity) but not as the primary name.
Li Wang: makes sense. suggest canonical doc names: `embedding` (the object), `embedding_id` (id), `embedding_vector` (the numeric array) so we keep explicitness. then show SDK casing variants.
Nina Park: love that. proposal for the style guide: "Docs use noun-first canonical names: `embedding`, `embedding_id`, `embedding_vector`. SDK snippets show idiomatic casing and explain mappings."
Owen Rivera: +1. also we should add a small "terminology at-a-glance" table in the glossary and a migration blurb for older examples that used `vector` alone.
Li Wang: I'll draft the glossary paragraph: `embedding (doc canonical) \u2014 dense representation produced by models. See embedding_vector for the numeric array and embedding_id for stable identifiers.`
Nina Park: include an example block to reduce copy-paste errors:
```
# Python (snake_case docs canonical)
emb = client.embed(texts=["hello"], embedding_id="emb-123")
print(emb.embedding_vector[:3])

// Node (camelCase SDK)
const res = await client.embed({ texts: ['hello'], embeddingId: 'emb-123' });
console.log(res.embeddingVector.slice(0,3));
```
Owen Rivera: add a sentence: "When documenting algorithms, you may use `vector` as a shorthand, but always clarify that `embedding_vector` is the canonical field name in docs."
docs-bot: Reminder: Docs PR template requires an impact assessment if we rename fields that appear in public examples.
Li Wang: migration checklist I propose: 1) grep for `embedding_vector`/`vector`/`embedding` ambiguity, 2) update quickstarts and cookbooks, 3) add mapping table in migration notes mapping old->new, 4) ping SDK teams to add aliases or changelog notes.
Nina Park: I'll open a PR with the glossary update + style guide text + three example snippets. PR link will be posted here. target: tomorrow morning.
SDK Lead: from SDK side: we'll add non-breaking aliases for one release and include a snippet in changelog showing `vector` -> `embedding_vector` mapping. we'll coordinate release timeline once the PR lands.
Owen Rivera: small UX nit: prefer examples to show both canonical doc name and actual SDK param in the same snippet (commented) so contributors copy-correctly.
Li Wang: good idea. will include commented examples in the PR.
Nina Park: tagging reviewers: @Owen, @Li, @SDK Lead. thanks all. :sparkles:
SDK Lead: thanks, will brief the SDK leads after the PR lands.
Nina Park: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4268 (WIP). I'll follow up with a grep-based report of files changed.
Owen Rivera: thanks!
Li Wang: :thumbsup:
